fields.name: snippet
fields.label: HTML Snippet
fields.description: Choose Blocks → Code block, then paste the HTML (optional <style> and <script>) into it. Only a code block keeps the HTML intact through publishing. For each /content/dam image in the snippet, add a Snippet Image (+) in the same order, so it's served optimized.

fields.name: renderInline
fields.label: Render inline (no frame)
fields.description: Off (default): the snippet renders in its own frame, so its CSS only styles the embed and the page's CSS doesn't change it. On: the snippet is added straight into the page, so its CSS can style the whole page and page CSS applies to it.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Pick the same DAM image the snippet uses. Snippet Images replace the snippet's /content/dam images in order: the 1st Snippet Image replaces the 1st image, and so on.
